scope.rule: 18 registry entries including one UNVERIFIED Microsoft verification-queue item; 17 product lines have official-source evidence. Registry ADD is not itself a market launch; missing or conflicting fields remain UNVERIFIED.

entries.name: Ethereum ecosystem
entries.why: Consensus/execution architecture and scaling roadmap benchmark for ATC protocol evolution.
unverified: client-specific release notes confirming the postponed schedule

previous.availability: The roadmap page listed Hoodi as the next milestone for 2026-10-27; the Ethereum Foundation's Hoodi announcement scheduled activation for 2026-10-26 17:42:48 UTC.

snapshot.availability: The Hoodi activation scheduled for 2026-10-26 17:42:48 UTC (epoch 132,352) was postponed on 2026-10-22. No replacement epoch or timestamp is set. The planned Hoodi gas-limit increase to 200M was removed. Mainnet activation remains unconfirmed.
features: gas-pricing changes intended to better reflect execution cost and state growth
snapshot.correction_note: The Ethereum Foundation update supersedes the earlier Hoodi schedule. Client release tables must not be treated as proof that a given client release includes the postponement unless its own release notes explicitly confirm it.

limitations: Roadmap is not proof of mainnet deployment.
entries.ARCHITECTURE_GAP: Potential governance check: bind activation state to explicit testnet, epoch/time, execution/consensus client versions and release-note evidence. A repository-level gap was not audited here.
entries.IMPLEMENTATION_PRIORITY: P1 — protocol governance and release-evidence benchmark
ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA: No activation is treated as scheduled without an official epoch/time and client-version matrix.
Execution and consensus client release notes explicitly confirm the applicable network configuration.
Superseded activation dates are marked withdrawn and cannot remain active in operator guidance.

snapshot.correction_note: These issue resolutions were published before this monitoring date and are captured as a snapshot-completeness correction, not as a new release on 2026-10-24.

entries.TARGET_SSOT: globus-os/modules/atc-shivacore/kernel/ and GlobusOS desktop/runtime SSOT; exact desktop SSOT path to confirm
entries.ARCHITECTURE_GAP: Reference only: release-health regressions in desktop startup and media paths should inform test coverage. No equivalent ShivaCore gap was audited in this run.
entries.IMPLEMENTATION_PRIORITY: P2 — use as regression-test reference, not as a product-change signal
ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA: Boot/login and desktop-session recovery tests are repeatable in QEMU and target hardware profiles.
Audio-decoding and application-session regressions have explicit tests where those features exist.
Release-health evidence is tied to a build/version and exact test result.

features: JIT or human approval for elevated privileges

entries.name: ServiceNow
entries.why: Long-running enterprise agent with memory/skills and policy enforcement at runtime; a direct benchmark for native agent authority and containment.
unverified: underlying Foundation, Advanced and Prime SKU prices
AI Passport GA and BlueField enforcement availability

snapshot.availability: Generally available as part of ServiceNow EmployeeWorks. The announcement says it is included at no additional cost with Foundation, Advanced and Prime SKUs; Mac support is live and Windows support is expected within weeks. AI Passport enforcement with NVIDIA OpenShell and BlueField is described as a future release.
features: long-running autonomous task ownership across workflows, email, Teams and other productivity tools
memory and skills that develop over time
runtime policy enforcement through Super Intelligence Control Tower and NVIDIA OpenShell
local inference option on NVIDIA RTX Spark for everyday tasks
action-level restrictions and revocation; vendor states propagation can be approximately one second
snapshot.pricing_note: Arc is described as included with specified ServiceNow SKUs, not as a separately priced product. Underlying SKU tariffs are not stated in the checked announcement.

limitations: The GA announcement is official, but the dedicated product page, standalone tariff, Windows availability date and future AI Passport release are not independently confirmed.
entries.ARCHITECTURE_GAP: Candidate comparison: long-running task lifecycle, memory/skills, and action-level runtime policy enforcement. The current native implementation gap has not been audited in this monitoring run.
entries.IMPLEMENTATION_PRIORITY: P1 — compare against existing Aurora Runtime and Authority Plane before implementation
ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA: Agent identity and delegated capabilities are explicit and revocable.
Tool/API/data access is denied by default and enforced at runtime.
Long-running tasks persist checkpoints without memory granting permissions.
Revocation and denial events are auditable and tied to an exact policy version.

entries.name: ARIS
entries.why: Provides process, role, system, rule, risk and control context to enterprise agents; adjacent benchmark for evidence-backed research and workflow planning.
unverified: independent validation of vendor-reported study results

snapshot.availability: Announced; ARIS says the product is available from 2026-10-26 and therefore was not yet generally available on this check date.
features: Object-Centric Process Mining to connect process design with execution evidence
Process Lens to identify where AI may have the greatest impact
MCP access to trusted process, role, system, rule, risk and control context
snapshot.vendor_research_note: The announcement cites a joint ARIS/The Hackett Group study. Its survey percentages are vendor-published and were not independently validated in this monitoring run.

limitations: Availability is future-dated relative to this check. Public tariffs, dedicated release notes and independent product validation were not found.
entries.TARGET_SSOT: aurora-ai for agent/context interfaces; Research Factory SSOT not confirmed in this run
entries.ARCHITECTURE_GAP: Potential capability to assess: versioned process-context graph connecting evidence, actors, systems, rules, risks and controls. Existing native coverage has not been audited here.
entries.IMPLEMENTATION_PRIORITY: P1 — architecture research; no implementation commitment until SSOT and gap are confirmed
ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA: Process context is versioned and every claim links to source evidence.
Agent queries are capability-scoped and return provenance plus freshness metadata.
Process, actor, system, risk and control relationships can be tested deterministically.
No external process-context service is required at runtime.

entries.name: Oracle
entries.why: Governed, long-running agent execution across enterprise outcomes, combining reasoning with deterministic computation, continuous replanning and human-approved actions.
unverified: dedicated product page for Fusion Claw
exact SKU and regional rollout for HR applications

snapshot.availability: Oracle's September 29 announcement said 25 Claw-powered Fusion Agentic Applications were available. The October 21 HR announcement describes new applications within Fusion Cloud HCM as available; exact SKU/region rollout was not independently confirmed.
features: AI reasoning combined with deterministic enterprise computation
governed execution within organizational objectives, permissions and constraints
human review and approval for actions
outcome receipt with authority, evidence, decisions, actions and results

limitations: The evidence is an official product announcement; it does not establish public pricing or availability for every SKU and region.
entries.TARGET_SSOT: aurora-ai for agent orchestration; Business Factory SSOT not confirmed in this run
entries.ARCHITECTURE_GAP: Potential capability to assess: deterministic execution steps and auditable outcome receipts around long-running agent tasks. Existing native coverage has not been audited here.
entries.IMPLEMENTATION_PRIORITY: P1 — compare against native factory pipeline before roadmap commitment
ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA: Each business outcome has an explicit objective, authority, policy and approval boundary.
Deterministic computations are separated from model-generated reasoning.
Every action and result is captured in a verifiable outcome record.
No external enterprise-agent runtime is required for core factory execution.

resolution.algorithm: ADD appends a new stable ID; UPDATE modifies the matching ID; REMOVE deletes the matching ID.
resolution.source_evidence: Targeted independent verification was performed for the BeyondTrust GA/integration pages and Linux 7.2.12 changelog. Other inherited entries remain at their prior evidence level.
